async function run(groups, other, read, output) {
	let done = 0
	for (const batch of groups) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await Promise.all(batch.filter((item) => item.enabled).map(read))
		done += batch.length
	}
	for (const batch of groups) {
		report(batch.length)
		const tasks = batch.filter((item) => item.enabled).map(read)
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all(tasks)
		output.push(...rows)
	}
	for (const batch of groups) {
		const tasks = batch.map(async (item) => {
			const row = await read(item)
			return row
		})
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		output.push(...(await Promise.all(tasks)))
	}
	for (const batch of groups) {
		const tasks = other.map(read)
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all(tasks)
	}
	for (const batch of groups) {
		const tasks = batch.map(read)
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await reportAsync(batch)
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all(tasks)
	}
}
